title: Avimi bar Pappi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was the colleague of Rav Nachman and Ulla, as in Ketubot 53a and Avodah Zarah 53b: “Rav Nachman, Ulla and Avimi bar Pappi were sitting, and Rav Chiyya bar Ami was sitting with them.” And as in Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:13: “Rabbi Zeira asked Rav Nachman bar Yaakov and Rabbi Avimi bar Pappi”; there in 6:6 the reading is Rabbi Ami bar Pappi, which Hyman identifies as the same person. In Ketubot 43a Avimi bar Pappi said to Rabbi Zeira: “Shakur said it.” So it is in the Jerusalem Talmud there, 4:2 and 4:13: “Rabbi Zeira sent to Rav Nachman bar Yaakov and to Rabbi Imi bar Pappi — he said to him: Shakur said it.”

notes.text: The supplied Shakur is retained alongside saved Davidson Ketubot 43b’s Shakud and Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:2’s Shoked, identified there as Shmuel. The supplied 43a locator remains rather than being erased. Hyman’s Ami/Avimi/Imi identification is attributed, not imposed on authorities.

The inspected Ketubot 43b has Avimi bar Pappi saying Shakud said it and identifies Shakud as Shmuel. The inspected Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:2 has Imi bar Pappi and Shoked. Hyman’s supplied Shakur, 43a locator and Ami/Avimi/Imi equation remain visible as his readings and identification.
